587-2226-2397.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
587-2226-2397.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sawtooth Loon by paying its mana cost.
When Sawtooth Loon enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand, draw four cards, and put four cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

513-1003-1778.easyPrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana cost {0} must be in your hand with the other being on the battlefield.
513-1003-1778.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your hand by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the other creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-6634.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1011-2034-2728-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2034-2728-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2034-2728-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Fate Transfer's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

277-2557-3129-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

348-1152-2992-4314-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2992-4314-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Pawn of Ulamog triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

348-1152-2301-3191-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2301-3191-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Abzan Ascendancy triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

2021-2060-2265-5902.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2097-4682-5140-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2097-4682-5140-7824.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Jolene and Bard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
2097-4682-5140-7824.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

104-3197-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

4644-5457-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with different powers.
4644-5457-7791.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Selvala.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Selvala.
Repeat.

2034-3693-5224-7729.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {2}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Walking Ballista, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-4496-6972.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat from step 2

586-5147-5258-5618-7646.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1642-7319.notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
1642-7319.description:
Declare Shredder as an attacker. Shredder's first ability triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of it attacking each other opponent that isn't legendary.
Deal combat damage using the Shredders. Each Shredder triggers, causing each opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn. Each opponent then loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1069-1256-5499-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-5499-7297.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

628-3967-7216.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

1061-1753-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-1753-4603.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-1753-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-745--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mirrorhall Mimic that has haste. Choose to have Mirrorhall Mimic enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Mirrorhall Mimic  token instead.
618-745--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Mirrorhall Mimic's toughness.

3490-3499-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3499-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

918-5109-6899.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Donna Noble instead due to With Great Power....
Donna Noble triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Dack's Duplicate.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Dack's Duplicate by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

628-2511-3108.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.
628-2511-3108.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

539-2783-5411-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1742-2035-6351.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gollum, adding {B}.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, returning Gollum from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1445-2097-2366-4826-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2097-2366-4826-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

56-1417-5256-6248.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-1417-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Bridge from Below and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-1417-5256-6248.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

855-1491-3755-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
855-1491-3755-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
855-1491-3755-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

413-678-5553.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Greedy Freebooter.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying {B}.
When Greedy Freebooter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2034-3169-4013-5263.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader enters the battlefield, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, causing it to return to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero enters the battlefield, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2249-2762.notablePrerequisites: Thopter Squadron has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2249-2762.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
When the Thopter dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron.
Repeat.

90-575-1794.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one additional black card in hand.
"Human" or "Assassin" chosen with Engineered Plague.
90-575-1794.description:
Cast Ruthless Ripper by paying {B}.
Ruthless Ripper dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Ruthless Ripper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face-up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
